programs.join: Join hundreds of educators who are already using TEAMIND to build essential life skills.
programs.early_detail_1_desc: Engaging group activities that introduce executive skills through storytelling and music.
programs.early_detail_2_desc: Smooth transitions between activities using character-based cues and songs.
programs.early_detail_3_desc: Reinforcing skills through structured and unstructured play scenarios.
programs.early_detail_4_desc: Helping children identify and express their feelings with the help of Molly the Mirror.
programs.early_detail_5_desc: Building the cognitive foundations necessary for a successful transition to elementary school.
programs.early_detail_6_desc: Reducing stress and behavioral issues through shared language and self-regulation tools.
programs.elem_detail_1_desc: 24 structured lessons that integrate seamlessly into the school curriculum.
programs.elem_detail_2_desc: Supporting improved behavior through self-regulation and impulse control.
programs.elem_detail_3_desc: Building stronger learning stamina and engagement in academic tasks.
programs.elem_detail_4_desc: Fostering healthier social interactions and empathy among students.
programs.elem_detail_5_desc: Encouraging greater responsibility and independence in daily school life.
programs.elem_detail_6_desc: Can be implemented with whole classes, small groups, or individual students.
programs.parents_detail_1_desc: Enjoy brain-boosting play that can involve the whole family.
programs.parents_detail_2_desc: Shape your child's behavior and support constructive thinking.
programs.parents_detail_3_desc: Support emotional regulation and empathy through character-based learning.
programs.parents_detail_4_desc: Use characters in real-time based on what your child is dealing with.
programs.parents_detail_5_desc: Develop essential life skills for independence and social participation.
programs.parents_detail_6_desc: Strengthen focus and attention to prepare for academic success.
programs.kit_character_sets_desc: 6 sets of character cards for students.
programs.kit_board_games_desc: Fun games for the whole family.
programs.kit_parent_guide_desc: Tips and strategies for home use.
programs.tip_1_desc: To build each executive function, repeat the game several times over a week or month for each character.
programs.tip_2_desc: Replaying songs and stories frequently helps children connect emotionally to the character and internalize the skill.
programs.tip_3_desc: Use the characters as gentle reminders to guide behavior in a playful way. Humor and consistency are key!
